span: The RT-95 runs a defrost cycle every 10 hours.

span: The RT-95 unit holds a refrigerant charge of 6.5 kg.

span: Check the rear door gaskets of the RT-95 at 50 day intervals.

span: The brake chamber stroke limit of the MX-300 is 33 mm.

span: The air dryer cartridge on the MX-300 is changed at 10 months.
text: MX-300 rigid truck - Air dryer cartridge interval The air dryer cartridge on the MX-300 is changed at 10 months. Only qualified technicians may adjust brakes.

span: Replace MX-300 tires when tread depth falls below 2.4 mm.
text: MX-300 rigid truck - Minimum tire tread depth Replace MX-300 tires when tread depth falls below 2.4 mm. Only qualified technicians may adjust brakes.

span: Change the MX-300 axle oil every 75000 km.

span: Free play above 30 mm at the steering wheel of the MX-300 must be corrected.

span: The MX-300 raises a coolant temperature alarm at 105 C.

span: Replace the MX-350 air dryer cartridge every 14 months.

span: Replace MX-350 tires when tread depth falls below 1.8 mm.

span: Change the MX-350 axle oil every 70000 km.

span: Maximum steering wheel free play on the MX-350 is 20 mm.

span: Seal leakage above 14 drops per minute on the CP-200 means the seal faces are worn and must be renewed.

span: The CP-200 needs a minimum NPSH margin of 0.6 m between available and required suction head.

span: Align the CP-200 shafts with a laser tool to within 0.08 mm.
